title: Review Comments File
description: Machine-readable schema for .local-code-review/<head-short-id>.json files. The top-level object is keyed by repository-relative file path. Each value is an ordered array of review comments for that file.

propertyNames.description: Repository-relative file path, for example src/client/App.tsx.

additionalProperties.description: Ordered list of comments for the file named by the property key.

comment.title: Review Comment
comment.description: Single comment anchored to one side of a diff at one line number.

id.description: Stable identifier used by the API for updating and deleting this comment. New files written by the tool include it; older files may omit it and are upgraded automatically on read.

side.description: Diff side that owns the line number. Use old for removed/pre-change lines and new for added/post-change lines.

line.description: 1-based line number on the selected diff side.

diffFingerprint.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest that identifies the exact diff version for this file. For tracked text files, it is computed from a normalized per-file `git diff HEAD --find-renames --patch --binary --no-color` representation that includes file metadata and added/removed lines, but excludes hunk headers and context lines. For untracked text files, it is computed from the file path, a synthetic hunk header, and normalized added lines. For untracked binary files, it is computed from the file path and file bytes. If it does not match the current fingerprint, the comment is treated as outdated.
